<title level="1" right="Action">[Grabbing Branches](/Actions.aspx?ID=2135) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 42

</column>

---

Your wood elemental surrounds a foe with branches, grabbing it in place. Your wood elemental makes a branch Strike; on a success, the target is also [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20) by the wood elemental until the end of your next turn unless your wood elemental moves or the target [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79).
name: Grabbing Branches
